text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Ryan Hardy has resigned from the Property Standards Committee effective March 14, 2024. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are planning to lead a recruitment and selection process to fill the vacant position in the coming months.
The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Received the letter (March 15, 2024) from the Manager, Public Appointments Secretariat on behalf of the City Clerk for information.
